title: Chapter 1039
text:
A mechanical army arrived at a barren, salt-white planet outside of the Star Zone. The surface of the planet was a boundless white desert.

Psionic Prime led his army and slowly landed on the white desert. A small black dot hovered one meter above the ground. It was a Divine Mechanical Throne.

Han Xiao's main body sat on it with his eyes closed. He focused on controlling the Lord's Avatar and the long-range troops. His entire body released blue-gold lightning, and the lightning snakes disappeared one meter away from his body. He entered the Quantum Infinite Distance Transmission channel and provided the troops with long-range support.

As the black army stepped onto the ground, Han Xiao opened his eyes at the same time.

"You're back?"

"Lord, we've completed our mission."

Psionic Prime walked at the front. He stabbed his spear into the ground and took out the magic ball container that sealed the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

Han Xiao looked over. Inside the translucent magic ball was the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy that had shrunk countless times. It was like a red cloud that kept changing shape.

"Well done."

Han Xiao picked up the magic ball and played with it in his hands. He then sized up the troops in front of him.

This army did not win easily against Ravenlaude at his peak state. A large number of normal troops were killed, and almost every mechanical soldier had battle scars on them. Many of them had broken armor, revealing their internal structure, which was still flashing with electric sparks.

Of the more than ten Apostle Weapons, four of them were paralyzed by Ravenlaude and carried to Han Xiao by their companions. They lay on the ground, unable to move, and Han Xiao had to kiss, hug, and lift them up high before they could … cough, they had to be fixed by him personally.

Apostle Weapons had self-repair abilities, but there was a limit. When the damage exceeded a certain level or the tinder energy was below the warning level, they would enter a state of paralysis or hibernation. These four Apostle Weapons were mainly close-combat types. They were all brutes like Mad Sky Hunter and Heaven-Suppressing Banner. Although they did not die in Ravenlaude's hands, they took tons of damage.

"Thank you for your hard work."

Han Xiao nodded. He raised his hand, and four silver nanoparticles gushed out and merged into the four Apostle Weapons. Their bodies trembled, and the external damage was slowly repaired.

"Let's leave it at that for now. If we want to completely repair it, we'll have to throw it into the secondary dimension arsenal for major repairs." Han Xiao casually explained. He then stared at Psionic Prime and smiled. "How is it? Did you get anything?"

Psionic Prime nodded. "Our neurons and memory banks have collected all the battle data. There are new cases in the database of Beyond Grade A battle patterns, which is more complete. The next time we deal with Ravenlaude or other Beyond Grade A Mages, we will be able to formulate more targeted strategies to reduce losses and increase efficiency."

The Apostle Weapons were all growth-type mechanical life forms. They had a strong learning ability. After fighting with all kinds of strong enemies, the stored battle process could be converted into actual combat experience for the Apostle Weapons, allowing them to become stronger and even learn special battle techniques.

"Very good. This is the first time you have defeated a complete Beyond Grade A without the help of the Lord's Avatar. I'm very satisfied with your results."

Han Xiao gave a few words of encouragement. He then had the mechanical army set up the space-stabilizing trap while he crushed the sealing crystal ball.

Ravenlaude had just sealed the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy when it was snatched away by Secret Master. He did not have the time to set up any magic seals, so it was enough for him to directly destroy the container. However, this simple and violent method could only be replicated by Beyond Grade As. Calamity Grades would not be able to destroy it.

Ka-cha!

The crystal ball shattered and exploded, turning into specks of light.

Boom!

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy broke free and instantly expanded. The first thing it did was to use was secondary dimension travel to escape. However, the mechanical army had already set up a trap, so it could not escape.

At this moment, Han Xiao raised his hand, opened his palm, and grabbed toward the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. He then made a pulling motion.

Whoosh!

A powerful suction force exploded, and the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy flowed toward Han Xiao uncontrollably. The red energy cloud was quickly absorbed into his body.

"Hiss …"

Han Xiao sucked in a breath of cold air, and a bright red light shot out from his eyes.

According to the Universal Civilizations' research on Primal Esper Ability Entities, only Espers and ordinary people could become the host. However, as Old Ma said, the truth comes from practice. Han Xiao planned to test the authenticity of the information himself. After all, his first choice was naturally to use it himself and see if he could adapt to it.

He was not worried about failure. The power of the backlash could kill a Calamity Grade, but it would only injure a Beyond Grade A at most. Humbly speaking, he felt that his recovery speed was barely passable, so he was not afraid at all.

Cells were the residence of Primal Esper Ability Entities. As soon as the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy entered his body, it automatically merged with every cell. Intense pain instantly exploded in Han Xiao's body!

Han Xiao could clearly feel that due to the difference in energy attributes, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy clashed with his own energy, forming a feeling similar to rejection. The more Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy his cells absorbed, the more intense the corrosive pain became.

However, compared to the pain of Promotion, this was nothing. Han Xiao frowned slightly, opened the status bar on the interface, and took a look.

Your body has been invaded by Primal Esper Ability Entities. Due to energy repulsion, you will receive 30,000 – 50,000 corrosive damage per second.

You have entered the [Cell Suppression (Energy Conflict Type)] state. Due to energy corrosion, the cells that provide energy to you are limited. -30% Health, Energy, and Stamina recovery rate.

You have entered the [Mild Weakness] state. Energy corrosion has weakened your body. -15% All Attributes, -15% Health, and -15% Energy.

You need to use additional energy to suppress the Primal Esper Ability Entities. Your Energy limit is temporarily reduced by 40%.

"Whoa, a bunch of negative statuses." Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

His original plan was that even if he could not adapt, he could try to use his own recovery speed to forcefully bear the burden of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and use it. However, seeing this bunch of negative statuses, he knew that this would not work.

"Looks like I won't be able to become the host."

Han Xiao shook his head. The energy in his body surged, and the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy in his body was directly ejected. He instantly felt refreshed, and all the negative statuses from before disappeared. He was full of energy again.

Before the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy could do anything, Han Xiao took out a containment device to restrain the energy entity. It looked like a seventy-centimeter-long mechanical tube with translucent yellow nano-glass in the middle. Without saying anything, he used the mechanical creation to contain the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy again.

The miniature version of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy inside tried to escape but could not pass through the special energy confinement field. Han Xiao shook the tube. Seeing the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy fall a few times because of his shaking, he could not help but chuckle.

"Although I won't be able to become the host, with my technology, it won't be hard to make use of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. The Mage class can seal it in a special puppet and turn it into a combat puppet. I can also build a special mechanical shell and turn it into the carrier of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, creating an artificial mechanical host. However, I'll need to conduct a comprehensive experiment to figure out how to create the carrier … "

Han Xiao secretly thought about how to cook the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. He was like a chef pondering about a precious ingredient, whether to steam or braise it.

At this time, a weak mental wave was released from the container, filled with helplessness. A neutral voice sounded in Han Xiao's mind.

"This unfamiliar Beyond Grade A, can we have a chat?"

Hmm? The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy is talking? That's right. After all, this guy is an independent lifeform that has not given up on thinking.

Han Xiao raised his brows and looked at the container in his hand with interest. He opened his mental barrier and formed a mental communication connection with the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

"You're the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy?"

"That's just what you call me. My real name is Mosaniel Cade Pieroye, the Red Spirit Ditte …"

After hearing a few dozen words, before the name was even finished, Han Xiao could not help but interrupt its self-introduction. "Stop, that's too troublesome. I'll just call you Ah Hun."

"Ah … Ah Hun …"

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's tone was stiff. It had probably never heard such a nice name before.

"Don't mind these details. What do you want to talk to me about?" Han Xiao raised his brows.

"What do you plan to do with me?"

Han Xiao thought about it and told it the truth. "I'll create a carrier that can accommodate you and let you fight for me. If that doesn't work, maybe I'll find a new host for you."

"I knew it." Surprisingly, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was not angry. "I've seen many Beyond Grade As. When I fused with you just now, I knew that you're one of the rare Beyond Grade As. I'm powerless to resist, so you can do whatever you want with my body. Be gentle, don't be too rough."

Why do you sound so weird?

Han Xiao coughed and asked curiously, "You're not angry that you've become my puppet?"

"My life is longer than you can imagine. I've experienced everything. You're not the first person to try to control me. You're just another passerby in my life," the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy said casually.

"… I didn't expect you to be so open-minded."

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. He did not know how to describe it. Had he already been taught by his predecessors?

"If you live as long as I do, you'll know the feeling of loneliness. It's the most terrifying feeling in the universe, so I've been sleeping most of the time. Instead, the experience of fighting side by side with every host is one of the few exciting memories in my life."

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was honest. As an ancient energy life form that spent most of his time sleeping, he did not bother to hide his true thoughts.

Han Xiao suddenly thought of what happened to Evans not long ago. "So, you actually really want to meet a host?"

"When I'm sleeping, I'll have my sub-bodies look for adapters everywhere. Whenever I'm interested, I'll find a host and start a new adventure."

Han Xiao's face twitched.

The world is really changing nowadays. Even an Esper Ability knows how to find a backup plan?

Pfft! Trash Esper Ability!

However, this did explain Evans' problem. It was a story of a backup plan.

There are way too many things to complain about … Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

"If you're so smart now, why did you run just now?"

"I prefer to take the initiative … but it's not like I can't enjoy being passive," the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy snorted.

To put it bluntly, you have to lower your head when you're under someone else's roof. You're quite smart, you coward … Han Xiao rolled his eyes.

He originally thought that the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy would resist fiercely and would rather die than submit. He did not expect his true nature to be so refreshing.

However, it made sense. An energy life form that had lived for so long probably did not care about many things. It definitely resisted when it was first caught, but as long as it crossed the bottom line, it would gradually slide into the abyss of true pleasure.

Han Xiao somewhat understood why the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy had such a personality. Although it was ancient, if it did not have enough strength, it would not be hard no matter how old it was.

That person said it well. If you can't resist, you can only enjoy. As time passed, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy gradually developed a calmness that went with the flow.

This time, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy took the initiative to talk to him. "I haven't woken up for a long time. What's the situation in the universe like now? What happened in the past few years? And who are you? Quick, tell me. "

"Since you're so cooperative, I'll tell you …" Han Xiao shook his head. Through the mental connection, he quickly sent a large amount of information to the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy looked at the information with great interest. "It seems like a lot of big things happened in the universe while I was asleep. I remember that when I was asleep, the Beyond Grade As were not even this batch, and there weren't so many of them either."

"How long have you been asleep for?" Han Xiao could not help but ask.

"A few hundred years or a thousand years? Sigh, how would I remember? Time means nothing to me. "

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy sighed and said in a tone that said, "Before the Beyond Grade As, we already existed.

"Before the birth of a Beyond Grade A, our Primal Esper Ability Entities already existed. I'm not trying to show off, but think about it. In the era where individual strength had yet to reach the Beyond Grade A level, we represented the pinnacle of combat strength. Countless people chased after our strength … Our era only ended when the Beyond Grade A level appeared.

The Primal Esper Ability Entities were extremely ancient. They definitely had a glorious history in the distant ancient universe. They might even be the 'main character' of a certain period.

This seemed to be a group with a lot of stories …

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat. "Then, do you know where the other Primal Esper Ability Entities are?"

"It's been so long. I don't know where they went …" This time, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy paused. His tone changed, suddenly filled with enthusiasm. "However, I might know where one of them is. If you're interested, I can help you catch him."

"… Why are you so excited all of a sudden?"

Han Xiao was suspicious.

Do you like beating up your teammates too?

"To tell you the truth, that guy and I are old enemies. I've always disliked him. A long time ago, we fought every day, and who knows how many hosts died. If you're interested in him, I'm very willing to help." The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy could not wait.

Hearing this, Han Xiao was a little surprised.

Not only did he catch the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, he even got an unexpected reward. Buy one, get one free?

Amazing, I clearly did not bring Fu Ding here!

Could it be that Secret Master pitied me and secretly gave me a wave of luck?

Hmm, this might be a trap.

Han Xiao stroked his chin and asked, "Then, what's it called?"

"Its name is Na … Oh, according to what you call it, it should be the Holy Light Particle."

Holy Light Particle?

Han Xiao's eyes flickered.

This was also a familiar name. Sharing the same husband with the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was the second Esper Ability that Evans had.

As an important character in EsGod's storyline, Evans had a lot of protagonist opportunities. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy wanted him to help take back the part of his body that EsGod had taken away, so it spared no effort to help him improve his strength. It was probably like today when it voluntarily revealed the existence of the Holy Light Particle.

Furthermore, Evans had a special physique and was actually compatible with the Holy Light Particle. The two Primal Esper Ability Entities reached some kind of agreement and decided to share a host. At that time, Evans was the first person in the entire universe to have multiple hosts, achieving the achievement of having multiple queens at once. The life of a harem-type protagonist was undoubtedly displayed.

Speaking of which, this young man is really a talent. Even if he can't be a host, recruiting him into the army can increase my luck.

"No problem. I don't mind having more Primal Esper Ability Entities. Where's the Holy Light Particle?" Han Xiao was interested.

"As far as I know, it has been entrenched in a secondary dimension for a long time. That's a world where light materializes. Everything is made up of colorful light. The solid light is like dazzling gems, and the liquid light is like thick and sticky milk …"

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy described it in as much detail as possible, showing its deep enmity toward its nemesis.

At the same time, Han Xiao's interface moved.

You have triggered the mission [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's Nemesis]!

Mission Introduction: You have captured the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. It is a very casual guy. If you can help it solve a small problem, it is willing to fight alongside you.

Mission Requirements: Defeat another Primal Esper Ability Entity, 'Holy Light Particle'.

Reward: 24 Gigabytes Experience, 2 Character Summon Cards, Special Milestone Mission unlocked — [Primal Esper Ability Collector]
